Cargo.toml.delta: Remove the unmaintained proc-macro-error2 dependency and all generated JavaScript build inputs.

src/lib.rs.delta: Provide a deterministic pass-through attribute compatible with the two cfg(doc) Matrix SDK call sites.

README.md.delta: Replace upstream behavior claims with the exact hermetic pass-through contract.

rationale: Aquamarine is used only by two documentation-mode Matrix SDK attributes. The archived implementation depends on unmaintained proc-macro-error2 and embeds about 11 MiB of generated JavaScript. The local compatibility macro is hermetic, performs no network access or script injection, and leaves Mermaid blocks as ordinary rustdoc code blocks. Runtime Matrix behavior is unchanged; Mermaid rendering is intentionally not preserved.
